description.value: Radium Hot Springs is a natural thermal pool operated by the Government of Canada on Highway 93, tagged in OSM as both a hot spring and a public swimming sports centre. It sits on a well-travelled cycling corridor between the Rockies and the Columbia Valley, making it a logical stop for riders crossing Sinclair Pass. Entry is fee-based and the facility is noted as wheelchair accessible.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned content from what appears to be a domain-squatter gambling site (hotsprings.ca now hosts a casino directory, not Parks Canada content), rendering it useless as an evidence source. All amenity fields must default to null; OSM tags are the only usable evidence. OSM confirms: Government of Canada operator, natural=hot_spring, sport=swimming, fee=yes, wheelchair=yes, at 5420 Highway 93.
concerns: OSM website URL (https://www.hotsprings.ca/radium) resolves to a third-party online casino/gambling directory site, not to the actual Radium Hot Springs / Parks Canada content — the domain appears to have been squatted or repurposed. The correct Parks Canada URL should be verified and updated in OSM.
No phone number present in OSM record.
All amenity fields are null due to website fetch failure; manual verification recommended.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Radium Hot Springs is a real, well-known, publicly accessible Parks Canada attraction on an active cycling corridor; the OSM record is valid and the facility is not closed.
enrichment_extras.notes: The actual operator is Parks Canada (Government of Canada). The authoritative website is likely on the parks.canada.ca domain; the hotsprings.ca domain is no longer associated with the facility.

wow_evidence: Parks Canada's famous hot pools below Sinclair Canyon — nationally known, and a soak after Sinclair Pass is day-shaping. Filed as Community Centre.
